descriptor.scene: Mira alone, sitting on the low concrete step with her elbows on her knees and her chin near her hands, looking out down the empty garden at nothing in particular. Stuck, thinking hard, brow faintly drawn, mouth closed and level. Two or three crashed paper planes lie forgotten in the grass near her feet, each a different fold. The SKY ABOVE THE GARDEN IS WIDE AND COMPLETELY EMPTY, taking up the upper half of the frame. Quiet, ordinary, unhurried. She is NOT crying, NOT wistful, NOT gazing at a sunset. No other people.
